_help: Everything specific to one institution. Another institution copies this file and changes the values. Texts with 'en' and 'nl' appear in the English and Dutch reports.

colours._help: primary: headings, links, main chart colour. accent: second chart colour and highlights. Hex codes.

main_units._help: Top-level collections that are the institution's main units (faculties, schools). Alias: short name. Every other top-level collection is shown as 'other collections'.

other_short_names._help: Optional short names for the other top-level collections. Without one, the collection's own name is used.
